evidence: Mycielski(C5) graph with 11 nodes, 20 edges analyzed. Exact backtracking proved χ=4 (3 colors insufficient, 4 sufficient). Greedy succeeded across 12 orderings when w (degree 5, adjacent to all u-nodes) colored last. DSATUR and local search both converged to 4 colors. The shadow construction: 5-cycle v0..v4 needs 3 colors, each ui adjacent to two non-adjacent cycle vertices mirrors cycle constraints, w adjacent to all ui forces 4th color.
statement: Mycielski construction of 5-cycle has chromatic number 4; greedy achieves optimum when the universal shadow vertex is colored after its neighbors.
